capabilities: Open a random past entry from chosen folders
Show notes written on the same date in past years
Save reflections to today's daily note with a link to the original
Browse entries as books with covers and a photo wall
Export notes as template images or WeChat-formatted articles
extras: Random review, on-this-day review, review history, comments and review-set management are free; the bookshelf, image export and WeChat layout need a per-device lifetime license activated by the author. First export downloads about 53 MB of fonts and images from GitHub, after which it works offline. Tested only on Windows desktop; mobile and the declared minimum Obsidian 1.7.2 are untested. Formulas, Dataview, whole-note embeds and other dynamic plugin content are not supported in exports, and the plugin does not upload or publish articles.
problem: Past journal entries are hard to rediscover in Obsidian, and turning a note into a styled image or WeChat article means copying it into another app.
summary: Journal review and reading tool that opens random past entries, shows on-this-day notes, and exports notes as styled images or WeChat articles.
